source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Here is the FAQ section. Please load it after adjusting anything that needs refinement.

What is Harbor Quill?
As the live proof of concept for CORA (Community Outreach Response Automation), Harbor Quill demonstrates the first system through which independent creators can sell unlimited-mint NFT ebooks while rewarding readers with real commissions and prizes for promoting it.
The launch features my raw memoir novella, “Against the Current: Finding the Finish Line,” on Base. It is also my public effort to support my household's recovery after a six-figure property fraud.
If CORA succeeds, Harbor Quill will develop into ArchiveLedger, a community-owned public-good platform available to every creator.

How do buyers earn money?
1. Earn a $10 instant commission whenever a buyer mints with your referral code
2. Receive Small & Big Block prize tickets whenever somebody mints using your code
3. ***If CORA proves successful, with zero guarantee of success or value***
Buyers, affiliates, and tippers of “Against the Current: Finding the Finish Line” will receive a future ArchiveLedger governance-token allocation.

How do referrals work?
Each NFT uses its token serial as its permanent referral code.
Both approaches work:
→ Share the entire link
→ Tell the buyer to “use referral 423”
When your code is used, you immediately receive $10 and the current Small & Big Block prize tickets.
→ If the mint has no referral code, the commission and tickets go to a random existing NFT holder.

Where do I find my referral code?
Your code is the token serial, shown:
- On the NFT itself
- Inside its NFT metadata
- On your Dashboard after minting
- Optionally, in the confirmation email

What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
Small Block awards 8 × $900 approximately every ~2,400 sales from mints and secondary transactions.
Big Block awards 9 × $6,000 approximately every ~180,000 sales from those same sources.
Every sale funds the pools forever.

How are winners selected?
Chainlink VRF performs the selection fully on-chain, with provable fairness and Basescan verification.

What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
These are entries for the active Small & Big Block drawings. Successful referrals provide 4 Small + 3 Big tickets, and additional tickets improve the chance of winning.
After a block is drawn, its tickets expire and new referrals apply to the next blocks.

How do I claim my rewards?
- $10 commissions → automatically transferred to your wallet
- Prize wins → posted on the Winners page and claimable with one click at <http://harborquill.example>

What are badges?
On-chain badges are attached to the NFT when referrals reach 5, 25, 125, 500+.
They currently provide cosmetic status and leaderboard flex. In the future, they may unlock token-gated chats, discounts, and other benefits.

Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes. Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

Do I need a wallet to participate?
A wallet is not needed to mint with fiat. It is required, however, if you want to receive commissions, hold prize tickets, or sell or trade the NFT later.

What blockchain is this on?
The project uses Base (Ethereum Layer 2), offering fast, inexpensive, and secure transactions.

Are there any hidden fees?
No. Each mint costs exactly $30, and secondary sales have a visible $48 flat royalty.

What happens if I sell my NFT?
The purchaser receives the book, the token serial as their referral code, all earned badges, and every active prize ticket; expired tickets remain expired.

How do I share my referral link/code?
Use the Dashboard to copy the complete link or the token serial, then tell people to “use referral 423”.

Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. It is single-level only, and the complete source is verified on Basescan. I receive $8 from every mint and secondary sale forever, minus fiat fees; everything else supports commissions and prize pools.

How do I contact support?
Discord is not available yet and will launch only after real traction develops.
For now, DM @HarborQuill on X or email elias@harborquill.example.

Anyone with further questions can DM @HarborQuill on X or contact elias@harborquill.example—I’m happy to assist.

decisions.reason: Adding a referral-code display location does not alter how the referral identity or other NFT properties behave after transfer.
Referral-code display locations do not change the commission allocation used when a mint has no referral code.
The display-location change does not alter the coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or cap.
Where the referral code is displayed does not change coded-referral ticket issuance or ticket quantities.
The referral-code display change does not modify badge thresholds, award basis, or NFT attachment.
Referral-code display locations do not affect ticket allocation when no referral code is supplied.
The display-location change has no effect on the randomness provider, winner-selection execution, fairness, or applicable draws.
The candidate already has a message-146 MODIFY replacing the prior FAQ with the complete revised copy, including the changed referral-code display language.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter the required blockchain network.
The referral-code display change does not affect the Discord server's deferred lifecycle or launch condition.
The referral-code display-location change does not modify mint pricing, commission amounts, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
